lab.code:
# 除法分组探索台
total = 12   # 总数量
each = 4     # 每组几个

hide()
groups = total / each
rem = total - groups * each
i = 0
while i < total:
    col = i - (i / each) * each
    row = i / each
    x = -180 + col * 26
    y = 70 - row * 30
    pen_color("blue")
    pen_down()
    go_to(x, y)
    go_to(x + 20, y)
    go_to(x + 20, y - 20)
    go_to(x, y - 20)
    go_to(x, y)
    pen_up()
    i = i + 1
write(total + " 个 ÷ 每组 " + each + " = " + groups + " 组", -190, 130, "red", 13)
if rem > 0:
    write("还剩 " + rem + " 个分不完整", -190, 105, "orange", 12)
if rem == 0:
    write("正好分完，没有余数！", -190, 105, "green", 12)
